title: Content moderation
loadFailed: Failed to load content moderation settings
policyRequiresEnabled: Enable content moderation before configuring moderation policies.
superAdminOnly: Only superadmins can manage moderation policy and service settings. View stats under Usage statistics and events under Logs.

surfaceDescriptions.inputText: Moderate prompts and text sent in the current turn.
surfaceDescriptions.inputImage: Moderate uploaded images used in the current turn.
surfaceDescriptions.outputText: Moderate text generated by the assistant in the current turn.
surfaceDescriptions.outputImage: Moderate generated images shown as reply attachments.

fields.apiKeyPlaceholder: Enter a new moderation API key

fieldDescriptions.enabled: Moderate conversation inputs and model outputs when enabled; service and policy settings are retained when disabled.
fieldDescriptions.baseUrl: An OpenAI-compatible service root, /v1 URL, or full /moderations URL.
fieldDescriptions.model: The model used for text and image moderation.
fieldDescriptions.apiKey: Leave blank to keep the current key, or enter a replacement and save.
fieldDescriptions.apiKeyRequired: Save an API key to test the connection and configure moderation policies.
fieldDescriptions.timeoutSeconds: Total wait time for one moderation check, from 1 to 60 seconds.
fieldDescriptions.maxConcurrency: Number of moderation tasks that can run at once, from 1 to 64.
fieldDescriptions.queueCapacity: Maximum number of queued moderation tasks, from 1 to 4096.

validation.apiKeyRequired: An API key is required before content moderation can be enabled.
validation.policyRequired: Select at least one moderation category before enabling content moderation.
